channel.title: Alumni AXIS Split — news
channel.description: News from the alumni association of the University Department of Professional Studies, University of Split.

item.title: CIET 2026 conference
item.description: The 7th international scientific and professional conference Contemporary Issues in Economy and Technology (CIET 2026), hosted by the University Department of Professional Studies, took place on 11–12 June 2026 in Split, with thematic workshops for students and staff. The programme, proceedings and participant information are on the conference website.

item.title: Electrical engineering students visit the Vrboran grid control centre
item.description: As part of the ongoing cooperation between the Department and the alumni association, students visited the Vrboran grid control centre to see how a control centre is organised and how the power system is managed in practice. item.title: Alumni AXIS Split becomes a full member of ASUS, the University of Split alumni association
item.description: The coordinating board of ASUS, the alumni association of the University of Split, has admitted Alumni AXIS Split — the association of graduates of the University Department of Professional Studies — as a full member. The membership opens up closer ties between current and former students, wider exchange of knowledge and experience, and joint planning of future activities and projects.

item.title: Electrical engineering students visit the Ogorje wind farm
item.description: Students visited the Ogorje wind farm to see how renewable generation facilities are operated and managed day to day. The guided tour and accompanying lectures connected classroom theory with practice in energy and sustainable development. The visit was led by lecturers Vjekoslav Zrno and Toni Karabatić.

item.title: Second annual general assembly held
item.description: At its second annual general assembly, the membership adopted the work programme for the coming period and the association's outline budget.

item.title: Science Comes to Town — organised with the Technology Transfer Office and the Electrical Engineering Section
item.description: Together with the Technology Transfer Office and the Electrical Engineering Section, the association helped organise the public presentation of the Science Comes to Town project. Tonko Kovačević, PhD, Vjekoslav Zrno, Marija Jelović and student Pjero Kalajžić demonstrated a visible-light communication system for wireless transfer of digital data.

item.title: First annual general assembly held
item.description: At its first annual general assembly, the membership reviewed results to date and set goals for the coming period.

item.title: Study trip for electronics and power engineering students
item.description: Electronics and power engineering students, accompanied by lecturers Marija Jelović, Tonko Kovačević and Vjekoslav Zrno, took part in a three-day study trip connecting classroom theory with industrial practice.

item.title: Founding assembly of Alumni AXIS Split
item.description: The founding assembly elected the association's board for the term from 20 October 2025 to 20 October 2029.
